Cancellation & Refund Policy

This policy covers cancellation and refunds for software development services provided by Subhankar Roy.

Last updated: 31 October 2026

How to cancel

To request cancellation, email subhankar.smith2003@gmail.com with your name and project or payment reference. Cancellation requests apply to future service or work not yet performed; any amount already due remains payable.

Recurring services

You may cancel a recurring service at any time by contacting us. Cancellation stops future renewals and takes effect at the end of the current paid billing period. Fees for the current period are not prorated or refunded, except where required by applicable law or agreed in writing.

Project-based services

If a project is cancelled, prepaid fees for work not yet performed will be refunded, less documented, non-refundable third-party costs incurred for the project. Fees for completed work or milestones are not refundable, except where required by applicable law or agreed in writing.

Refund processing

Approved refunds are issued through the original payment method where possible. Processing and posting times may depend on the payment provider and financial institution.

Contact

For cancellation or refund questions, visit Customer Support or email subhankar.smith2003@gmail.com.
